text:
maya: Heads-up: PM sync — we need to finalize v2 deprecation phasing and route mapping for next quarter. Main asks: (1) which v1 routes can be sunset now, (2) customer exemptions, (3) launch gates. I put a draft mapping below. Please weigh in by EOD.
diego: quick note: v1/chat_stream is still used by two internal services. need migration window >= 8 weeks or a shim.
sam: From perf: v2/chat has ~20% lower latency at typical payloads, but embeddings v2 has different vector dims for some models. need explicit compatibility layer for embeddings.
anya: Customer-success: two enterprise customers (FinCo, HealthCorp) require private deployment compatibility and 6mo notice on deprecations. they'll ask for opt-in to keep v1.
maya: Draft mapping below — also proposing deprecation phases: soft-deprecate (announce + shim) -> hard-deprecate (disable).
```json
{
  "v1/completions": "v2/generate",
  "v1/chat_stream": "v2/chat.stream",
  "v1/embeddings": "v2/embeddings.v2",
  "v1/rerank": "v2/rerank"
}
```
diego: question: embeddings dims change — can we accept both dims and normalize on server? that's extra CPU.
sam: yes, we can normalize in postproc but need perf budgets. suggest: allow both in a transition mode with warning header `X-Compat-Mode: v1`.
maya: Launch gates: 1) 95th perc latency <= target for v2, 2) migration tools/CLI available, 3) Customer opt-in flows in Console, 4) migration guide + sample code. Who owns the migration guide?
anya: i'll own the guide drafting with SE help. need list of customer-specific escape hatches (longer notice, private v1 windows).
diego: i'll own the shim and rollout. can we schedule canary in dedicated env for 2 weeks?
release-bot: deploy scheduled: canary to dedicated-staging on 2035001500 by diego. CI checks pending.
maya: decision: proceed with 3-phase rollout (announce + shim -> canary -> global). action items: diego -> shim & canary (due 2035001600), sam -> perf budget & metrics (due 2035001700), anya -> customer comms & guide (due 2035001750). i'll assemble final timeline and send to execs.
sam: also: add auto-fallback policy so older clients fallback to v1-compatible model variant under load (configurable).
diego: :thumbsup: will add fallback policy and config flag `compat.mode=allow-v1`.
anya: :wave: will collect affected customer list and slack them this week, plus prepare tailored migration notes.
maya: closing thread — thanks everyone, i’ll post the timeline doc later today.
